entities.summary: Mark Olver is a Canadian-German professional ice hockey centre currently playing under contract to the Idaho Steelheads of the ECHL. He previously played in the National Hockey League with the Colorado Avalanche. Mark is the younger brother of Darin Olver, who was his teammate in his tenure with Eisbären Berlin.
